preregistered.question: whether each retained compilation seed of the packed set-4 layout group returns its retained computed_circuit after the chip's recalibrations, and whether each mesh's deviation from its block's four-mesh mean recurs
preregistered.observable: per block and iteration, a = (samples with exactly one click in the block's slot that land on an algebra mode) / (samples with exactly one click in the slot), the observable of scripts/qd_packed_mode_swap_analysis.py
preregistered.identity: per seed, the sha256 of the returned computed_circuit against the retained digest of the same circuit_params and compilation_seed; both primary repeats must return the primary digest. Any mismatch reads 'seed does not reproduce its mesh' and withholds the persistence statistic
preregistered.drift: per block, the two-sample z of the two new primary repeats; D = sum z^2 on 6 degrees of freedom; drift detected at p < 0.01 withholds the persistence reading
preregistered.statistic: per block b and mesh j (the pooled primary repeats, then each replicate), e = a - mean over the four meshes of a, in the retained window and in the new one; T = sum over b and j of e_old e_new
preregistered.null: no persistence: within each block the new mesh labels are exchangeable; the exact one-sided p-value is the share of the 24^6 within-block relabelings with T at or above the observed T
preregistered.slope: beta = T / sum e_old^2, the regression through the origin of e_new on e_old, with its one-sided 0.95 upper bound beta + t(0.95, dof) s / sqrt(sum e_old^2), s^2 the residual variance on 24 - 6 - 1 = 17 degrees of freedom
preregistered.reading: persists when p < 0.05; redrawn when p >= 0.05 and the upper bound on beta is below 0.5; indeterminate otherwise
preregistered.secondary: the same T restricted to slots 4 and 5 (chip modes 16 to 23, the teleportation layout's modes) and with slot 5 excluded, reported without a reading
